title: Extra Amarite Blocks
description: Addon of Amarite that adds extra Amarite blocks.
body:
# Adds extra building blocks out of Amarite.

Small addon, it's exactly as it says. Current list of features includes:

- Amarite Bricks
  - Stair
  - Slab
  - Wall
- Gilded Amarite Bricks
  - Stair
  - Slab
  - Wall
- Amarite Pillar
- Chiseled Amarite

I hope you enjoy this blasted paint blocks 2 ahh mod!
